LOCAL.TITLE: Stored on your phone
LOCAL.SUBTITLE: No account and no internet needed

NICKNAME.TITLE: What should we call you?
NICKNAME.SUBTITLE: Only used to greet you on the home screen. Stored on this phone and can be changed anytime.
NICKNAME.LABEL: Nickname

WALLET_SETUP.TITLE: Where is your money right now?
WALLET_SETUP.SUBTITLE: Pick the wallets you use and enter their current balance. A rough guess is fine, you can adjust it later.

PIN.CREATE_SUBTITLE: Four digits to lock your records
PIN.CONFIRM_SUBTITLE: Enter it once more to make sure
PIN.LOGIN_SUBTITLE: Your records are stored only on this phone
PIN.LOCKED_SUBTITLE: For your security, the PIN is temporarily locked
PIN.LOCKED_HINT: Try again when the countdown ends

NOTIF_PERMISSION.TITLE: Can we remind you?
NOTIF_PERMISSION.SUBTITLE: Notifications are only used for these three things, never for promotions.

POINTS.DAILY: A reminder to log, once a day
POINTS.RECURRING: Recurring bills that were just recorded
POINTS.DEBTS: Debts and loans nearing their due date

BIOMETRIC_OFFER.TITLE: Unlock with fingerprint?
BIOMETRIC_OFFER.SUBTITLE: Faster than typing your PIN. Your phone checks the fingerprint; Artamu only receives whether it succeeded.

FORGOT_PIN.TITLE: Forgot PIN
FORGOT_PIN.BODY: This app has no account, so your PIN can't be sent to you. There are two ways:
FORGOT_PIN.BIOMETRIC: Use fingerprint, then create a new PIN
FORGOT_PIN.PROMPT: Verify to create a new PIN
FORGOT_PIN.WIPE_HINT: Can be restored if you have a backup file

WIPE.TITLE: Erase all data?
WIPE.BODY: Transactions, wallets, categories, recurring bills, debts, and your PIN will be erased from this phone. This can't be undone.
WIPE.LABEL: Type {{word}} to continue

HOME.HINT_WALLET: Tap the wallet name on the card to switch wallets.
HOME.SPENDING_MORE: By day {{day}} you spent {{amount}}, {{diff}} more than {{month}} by the same day.
HOME.SPENDING_LESS: By day {{day}} you spent {{amount}}, {{diff}} less than {{month}} by the same day.
HOME.CHART_LABEL: Cumulative spending this month compared with {{month}}. Open report

DB_ERROR.WEB_TITLE: Artamu is open in another tab
DB_ERROR.WEB_BODY: Browser storage can only be used by one tab at a time. Close the other Artamu tabs, then reload this page.
DB_ERROR.TITLE: Your data couldn't be opened
DB_ERROR.BODY: Something went wrong while opening your records. Try again; if it keeps failing, restart the app.
